title_working: Which Pill Would You Take For A Million Dollars?

lines.text: Which pill would you take for a million dollars?
lines.say: (confident) Which pill would you take for a million dollars?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: A stranger hands you three pills. You must swallow one to get the money.
lines.say: (happy) A stranger hands you three pills. You must swallow one to get the money.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The blue pill gives you super strength.
lines.say: (happy) The blue pill gives you super strength.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: But you can only use it one day a year, and after that, you are weak for a whole month.
lines.say: (nervous) But you can only use it one day a year, and after that, you are weak for a whole month.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The red pill lets you read every mind around you.
lines.say: (happy) The red pill lets you read every mind around you.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: But you can never turn it off. Every thought, all day, forever.
lines.say: (nervous) But you can never turn it off. Every thought, all day, forever.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The green pill gives you speed, strength and flight, with no downside at all.
lines.say: (happy) The green pill gives you speed, strength and flight, with no downside at all.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: But to take the green pill, you have to subscribe and comment which pill you chose.
lines.say: (happy) But to take the green pill, you have to subscribe and comment which pill you chose.
lines.speaker: narrator
